summary: Auric's opened luxury ring is shelter, not safety: refugees wake beneath chandeliers while longtime residents discover strangers occupying abandoned homes.
settingText: INT. AURIC BAZAAR — LUXURY RING CONCOURSE — MORNING

dialogueInline.speaker: Resident
dialogueInline.text: My parents' things are still in there.

dialogueInline.speaker: Richard
dialogueInline.text: We were told the rooms were empty.

dialogueInline.speaker: Halev
dialogueInline.text: No one is being put outside.

dialogueInline.speaker: Sera
dialogueInline.text: Then tell her where her parents go.

directionInline: Begin inside Issue Two's consequence. Nobody is a villain; rescue has become a conflict over home, and Halev's promise is exposed as incomplete.
panelPlan: Wide chandelier concourse converted into a crowded shelter.
A resident confronts Richard at her sealed family apartment.
Paul moves protectively between the adults.
Halev arrives as Dain refuses an easy eviction.
Both families remain on opposite sides of one doorway.

summary: A shared heat failure forces two families into one room; Richard saves a resident child with medicine carried out of Tal Corvus.
settingText: INT. LUXURY RING — TEMPORARY APARTMENT

dialogueInline.speaker: Richard
dialogueInline.text: Then tell me what she took.

dialogueInline.speaker: Richard
dialogueInline.text: Blue lips. Shallow breath. She isn't fine.

directionInline: Gratitude complicates the dispute without erasing it; medicine becomes relationship, not inventory.
panelPlan: Emergency lights and visible breath crowd both families together.
The resident child collapses.
Richard opens his last field kit.
Paul steadies the lamp while the mother holds her child.
The child breathes as the adults meet eyes without reconciliation.

summary: Venn leaves for tribunal; Naomi believes the Fleet is withdrawing its most trustworthy person exactly when Auric needs her.
settingText: INT. AURIC DOCK — DEPARTURE GLASS

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: They relieve you, and you still go when they call.

dialogueInline.speaker: Venn
dialogueInline.text: If I refuse the hearing, Keating writes the reason for me.

dialogueInline.speaker: Venn
dialogueInline.text: Then I say it where she can't bury it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: Auric gets the consequences. The Core gets your conscience.

dialogueInline.speaker: Venn
dialogueInline.text: Enough to wish you were wrong.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: Come back with more than a wish.

directionInline: Respect and attraction live beneath a real political wound; avoid a sentimental farewell.
panelPlan: Venn's escort shuttle waits beyond immense glass.
Naomi blocks Venn's path.
Their controlled anger closes the distance.
Venn almost reaches for Naomi and stops.
Venn boards while Naomi remains reflected beside the shuttle.

summary: Dominion frames Venn's tribunal as a clean command failure; Kerr forces the dead and saved back into the record.
settingText: INT. DAWNWARD HORIZON — ADMIRALTY TRIBUNAL — DAY

dialogueInline.speaker: Dominion
dialogueInline.text: Did you understand the withdrawal order?

dialogueInline.speaker: Keating
dialogueInline.text: And Billie Rusk escaped under your restraint.

dialogueInline.speaker: Keating
dialogueInline.text: Because restraint left her able to.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kerr
dialogueInline.text: The civilians are alive because Venn returned.

dialogueInline.speaker: Dominion
dialogueInline.text: This court is not weighing sentiment.

directionInline: Establish the institution's preferred narrow story and Venn's refusal to inhabit it.
panelPlan: Venn stands alone below the circular Admiralty dais.
Keating projects Billie's escape and the damaged tug.
Dominion reduces the events to the order chain.
Kerr activates civilian testimony.
Venn faces accusation and survivors simultaneously.

summary: Richard discovers medical proof that the Triarch manufactured the refugee crisis by cutting heat and medicine to disloyal districts.
settingText: INT. AURIC LUXURY RING — IMPROVISED CLINIC

dialogueInline.speaker: Richard
dialogueInline.text: No. They were turned off one at a time.

dialogueInline.speaker: Tess
dialogueInline.text: If this leaves the room, they come for you.

dialogueInline.speaker: Richard
dialogueInline.text: They already came for everyone else.

directionInline: Evidence emerges through patients and memory, never a technical briefing.
panelPlan: Richard treats locals and refugees side by side.
He compares identical tissue damage across records.
Paul recognizes district names.
Tess sees the deliberate sequence.
Richard holds the archive chip as a dangerous object.

summary: Halev asks Auric to extend shelter; Dain makes him admit that Verge families will pay for the promise.
settingText: INT. AURIC BAZAAR — CIVIC CHAMBER

dialogueInline.speaker: Halev
dialogueInline.text: No one goes back to Tal Corvus.

dialogueInline.speaker: Sera
dialogueInline.text: Another section lost heat last night.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: Finish that sentence and I'll price you into an airlock.

dialogueInline.speaker: Sera
dialogueInline.text: My district is sleeping six to a room.

dialogueInline.speaker: Halev
dialogueInline.text: What do you want from me?

directionInline: Both Halev and Dain are morally serious; his inability to name who pays is the turn.
panelPlan: The crowded chamber overlooks refugees beyond glass.
Halev asks for an extension.
Dain shows failing residential levels.
Wallace's market answer is rejected.
Naomi makes Halev name the harmed district.

summary: Families forced together refuse to reduce one another to abstractions when a local child needs refugee care.
settingText: INT. LUXURY RING — WARMING ROOM

dialogueInline.speaker: Boy
dialogueInline.text: Were these rooms always this cold?

dialogueInline.speaker: Paul
dialogueInline.text: No. They used to be ugly and warm.

dialogueInline.speaker: Paul
dialogueInline.text: Want to see a light trick?

directionInline: Distrust changes into provisional coexistence through action.
panelPlan: Families pack around one improvised heater.
The resident child struggles to breathe.
Refugees surrender blanket and space.
Paul distracts the frightened children while Richard works.
The resident mother makes room for Richard.

summary: Public knowledge of Jex's passage turns refuge into a hunted commodity; Tali warns him to close the remaining network.
settingText: INT. VEIL MARKET — JEX'S OFFICE / TALI'S SAFEHOUSE

dialogueInline.speaker: Tali
dialogueInline.text: Three strangers asked for your passage by name.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jex
dialogueInline.text: Only three? Fame has been unkind.

directionInline: Tali is Jex's younger sister and moral equal, not hostage exposition.
panelPlan: Jex is surrounded by competing demands.
A private distorted-glass call resolves into Tali.
Her refuge quietly prepares to disappear.
Jex receives another plea from trapped families.
His hands hover between closing and accepting the route.

summary: The Triarch offers peace if Auric returns Richard, forcing Paul to ask whether his surrender might save everyone else.
settingText: INT. IMPROVISED CLINIC — BROADCAST LIGHT

dialogueInline.speaker: Triarch
dialogueInline.text: Return Richard Secundo. Reject Fleet occupation. Trade resumes.

dialogueInline.speaker: Paul
dialogueInline.text: If you go, do they leave Auric alone?

dialogueInline.speaker: Paul
dialogueInline.text: Would you do it for me?

dialogueInline.speaker: Richard
dialogueInline.text: For you, I would do almost anything.

directionInline: Make the dilemma intimate; Richard cannot promise that refusal is harmless.
panelPlan: Clinic screens seize into a masked broadcast.
The Triarch promises restored trade and amnesty.
Richard is publicly labeled thief and traitor.
Paul studies his father while patients watch.
Richard kills the screen but cannot answer him.

summary: Abby arrives alone with warning of Billie and Pike's gathering force; Auric must decide whether a disarmed Shard warlord may enter.
settingText: INT./EXT. AURIC SECURITY LOCK

dialogueInline.speaker: Abby
dialogueInline.text: Because Billie found captains who prefer revenge to survival.

dialogueInline.speaker: Abby
dialogueInline.text: I want you alive enough to hate me tomorrow.

directionInline: Abby's public split already happened; this tests its cost and grants conditional access, not forgiveness.
panelPlan: Abby's tiny shuttle waits while Scythe remains distant.
She places her weapons in the lock tray.
Dain faces her through armored glass.
Abby shows Pike and Billie's gathering force.
Halev opens the door while Naomi remains ready.

summary: Abby expects Tess, her sister, to return; Tess refuses to abandon people harmed by captains they once led.
settingText: INT. AURIC LUXURY RING — CLINIC PASSAGE

dialogueInline.speaker: Abby
dialogueInline.text: Billie's gone. Pike chose her. Come home.

dialogueInline.speaker: Tess
dialogueInline.text: My sister commanded people who did this.

dialogueInline.speaker: Abby
dialogueInline.text: You think leaving me repairs it?

directionInline: The sisters cannot return to what they were; Tess means confession where Abby hears judgment.
panelPlan: The sisters see each other across the crowded clinic.
Abby offers Tess her command token.
Tess continues dressing a civilian wound.
Abby absorbs the refusal.
The token remains on an empty cot between them.

summary: Kerr offers Venn a defensible lie; Venn insists the tribunal judge her actual rejection of Dominion's order.
settingText: INT. ADMIRALTY TRIBUNAL — RECESS ALCOVE

dialogueInline.speaker: Kerr
dialogueInline.text: Say the return protected Fleet strategic interests.

directionInline: Kerr is an ally, not a coward; Venn chooses moral clarity over acquittal.
panelPlan: Venn and Kerr stand behind a translucent screen.
Kerr offers the prepared defense.
Venn deletes it.
Kerr warns her what honesty costs.
Venn returns without notes.

summary: Keating freezes Fleet support to Auric, making Verge civilians bear part of the punishment for Venn's choice.
settingText: INT. AURIC ESCORT CONTROL / LUXURY RING

dialogueInline.speaker: Deka
dialogueInline.text: Thunderbreak is ordered outside the boundary.

dialogueInline.speaker: Deka
dialogueInline.text: Commodore Venn no longer commands this ship.

dialogueInline.speaker: Sera
dialogueInline.text: And we went dark while she spoke.

directionInline: The tribunal produces immediate human consequences.
panelPlan: Naomi receives the withdrawal order.
Thunderbreak recedes beyond Auric jurisdiction.
The clinic loses a Fleet power feed.
Dain sees a shelter level go dark.
Naomi closes Venn's personal channel without calling.

summary: Richard agrees to independent testimony only if his evidence cannot authorize Fleet occupation and Paul may remain private.
settingText: INT. AURIC ARCHIVE BOOTH — NIGHT

dialogueInline.speaker: Halev
dialogueInline.text: Broadcasting from Auric paints the station around you.

dialogueInline.speaker: Richard
dialogueInline.text: The target was painted before I arrived.

dialogueInline.speaker: Sera
dialogueInline.text: Your conditions go into the record first.

dialogueInline.speaker: Richard
dialogueInline.text: No Fleet custody. No occupation justified in my name.

directionInline: Father and son love each other without agreeing; Richard owns his evidence.
panelPlan: A neutral archive booth waits dark.
Halev warns of the target risk.
Richard sets his terms.
Paul refuses the seat beside him.
Dain activates the uneditable public record.

summary: Richard names individual victims; testimony spreads because it refuses strategic abstraction.
settingText: INT. AURIC ARCHIVE / INTERCUT TAL CORVUS

dialogueInline.speaker: Richard
dialogueInline.text: Nemi Vale. Six weeks old. Incubator power denied.

dialogueInline.speaker: Richard
dialogueInline.text: Ors Dane. Antibiotics withheld after his district protested.

dialogueInline.speaker: Richard
dialogueInline.text: Sergeant Pell carried medicine to children. They executed him for theft.

dialogueInline.speaker: Another Listener
dialogueInline.text: Send it before they cut the channel.

dialogueInline.speaker: Richard
dialogueInline.text: They called these shortages. They were choices.

directionInline: Every record is a person and triggers someone else's action.
panelPlan: Richard sits alone before the camera.
An infant's record becomes a remembered face.
A Shard engine crew stops to listen.
Paul hears familiar names outside the booth.
Anonymous hands retransmit the archive.

summary: Billie accepts Pike's strike because Richard's truth makes Abby and Tess's rejection impossible to dismiss as weakness.
settingText: INT. BROKEN OATH — WAR ROOM

dialogueInline.speaker: Pike
dialogueInline.text: Now she chooses who governs the Shards.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pike
dialogueInline.text: Abby ran. Tess hid behind bandages. The doctor makes it virtue.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pike
dialogueInline.text: Then give her somewhere to stand.

dialogueInline.speaker: Billie
dialogueInline.text: No. Make them watch her fail.

directionInline: Pike weaponizes Billie's personal wound; she knowingly escalates beyond Issue Two.
panelPlan: Richard's testimony fills the battered display.
A named child's death affects Billie.
Pike overlays the Auric attack path.
Billie sees the clinic marker.
She takes the strike control key.

summary: Shard sleepers sabotage the luxury ring and plant Richard's insignia, turning residents against refugees as heat fails.
settingText: INT. LUXURY RING — HEAT EXCHANGE / CONCOURSE

dialogueInline.speaker: Halev
dialogueInline.text: Not by a badge left where you'd find it.

directionInline: Sabotage attacks social trust as much as infrastructure.
panelPlan: A gloved hand destroys the exchanger and plants insignia.
Lights die across the concourse.
Residents find the planted evidence.
Accusation becomes a physical fight.
Richard places himself between Paul and the crowd.

summary: Naomi forces Halev and Dain to tell everyone the ring may fail, choosing public trust over managed calm.
settingText: INT. AURIC CIVIC BROADCAST PLATFORM

dialogueInline.speaker: Halev
dialogueInline.text: Say that now and people run.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: They're already running. They don't know where.

dialogueInline.speaker: Sera
dialogueInline.text: The ring may not have one.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: What we know and what we don't.

dialogueInline.speaker: Halev
dialogueInline.text: The ring may not remain habitable.

directionInline: Truth causes fear but ends rumor-based violence and invites voluntary action.
panelPlan: The three argue while a crowd pounds the doors.
Halev asks for delay.
Dain demands evacuation.
Naomi activates the live feed mid-argument.
They face the frightened station together.

summary: Halev and Dain surrender their own security before asking residents and refugees to share shelter.
settingText: INT. AURIC INNER SHELTER GATE

dialogueInline.speaker: Sera
dialogueInline.text: Where I was asking you to go.

directionInline: Leadership becomes costly and visible; capacity is not magically solved.
panelPlan: Officials privilege registered residents.
Richard turns away with Paul.
Halev tears up his own authorization.
Dain gives away her family berth.
Mixed families enter while both leaders remain outside.

summary: Jex learns the public passage is watched; saving the ring requires exposing Tali's remaining private haven network.
settingText: INT. JEX'S OFFICE / TALI SAFEHOUSE / AURIC MAP

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: Your famous passage is a firing gallery.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: That sounded like a lie with a witness.

dialogueInline.speaker: Tali
dialogueInline.text: They'll see everyone if you don't.

directionInline: End before the choice executes; Tali chooses with Jex rather than being passively sacrificed.
panelPlan: The public passage is surrounded by hostile contacts.
Naomi asks for another way.
Jex reveals a faint hidden web.
Tali understands his consideration.
Her haven glows as one node among many.

summary: Jex opens the private routes, saving the ring while Tali's refuge disappears from his board.
settingText: INT. JEX'S OFFICE / EXT. AURIC HIDDEN APERTURES

dialogueInline.speaker: Jex
dialogueInline.text: Once I send this, there are no private doors.

dialogueInline.speaker: Tali
dialogueInline.text: There are people behind the public ones.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: I can protect the ships. Not every origin.

directionInline: Make the hidden community wondrous and the loss immediate; Jex makes no bargain.
panelPlan: Jex releases the authentication web.
Concealed apertures ignite around Auric.
Civilian craft emerge toward the ring.
Tali's node flashes exposed.
It goes black under Jex's hand.

summary: Billie and Pike attack the evacuation; Billie drives toward Richard while civilians cross exposed spans.
settingText: EXT./INT. AURIC LUXURY RING — UNDER ATTACK

dialogueInline.speaker: Billie
dialogueInline.text: It was split before we arrived.

directionInline: Escalation is deliberate and personal; civilians remain central to the spectacle.
panelPlan: Pike's force erupts through fractured ring light.
Evacuation craft scatter.
Billie drives Ashfang into the structure.
The clinic ceiling tears as Tess shields Richard and Paul.
Billie sees the clinic marker ahead.

summary: Naomi accepts Abby's ships only under Verge command and only to protect civilians.
settingText: INT. AURIC ESCORT CONTROL / ABBY'S SHUTTLE

dialogueInline.speaker: Abby
dialogueInline.text: I have six captains outside your line.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: They answer to me. They cover civilians. They do not pursue.

dialogueInline.speaker: Abby
dialogueInline.text: You're putting me on a leash.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: I'm putting you between families and guns.

directionInline: Cooperation is conditional, politically unequal, and chosen.
panelPlan: Evacuation craft fill Naomi's displays.
Abby offers her remaining ships.
Naomi rejects broad command access.
She assigns civilian shield duty.
Abby relays the order to her defectors.

summary: Verge escorts, Abby's defectors and Auric workers fight together while Thunderbreak watches beyond jurisdiction.
settingText: EXT. AURIC BAZAAR — RINGSPACE BATTLE

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: Civilian three, break toward the gold strut.

dialogueInline.speaker: Abby
dialogueInline.text: Then stop telling me and fly.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: Thunderbreak, people are dying in front of you.

directionInline: Action remains legible through rescue choices, not formation chatter.
panelPlan: Escorts thread luminous ring architecture.
Abby's ships take fire for refugee craft.
Workers launch rescue skiffs by hand.
Thunderbreak holds beyond the boundary.
Deka watches a civilian ship tumble toward fire.

summary: Dominion offers Venn restoration for withdrawal and Richard's transfer; Venn refuses and leaves her crew to choose.
settingText: INT. ADMIRALTY TRIBUNAL / THUNDERBREAK BRIDGE

dialogueInline.speaker: Dominion
dialogueInline.text: Resume command. Withdraw Thunderbreak. Transfer Vey afterward.

dialogueInline.speaker: Venn
dialogueInline.text: You offer me my ship in exchange for a woman.

dialogueInline.speaker: Dominion
dialogueInline.text: Then you have no order to give.

dialogueInline.speaker: Venn
dialogueInline.text: He is right. I cannot command you.

dialogueInline.speaker: Venn
dialogueInline.text: You can see who is beneath those weapons.

directionInline: Venn does not order mutiny; honesty inspires an independent moral act.
panelPlan: Battle footage fills the tribunal.
Dominion presents restoration orders.
Venn leaves them untouched.
Her unauthorized channel reaches Thunderbreak.
Deka advances the ship across the boundary.

summary: Billie reaches Richard's clinic; Tess finally stops the woman she kept calling family.
settingText: INT. LUXURY RING — CLINIC PRESSURE CORRIDOR

dialogueInline.speaker: Billie
dialogueInline.text: Strangers get the loyal version of you.

dialogueInline.speaker: Tess
dialogueInline.text: They get the version that finally chose.

dialogueInline.speaker: Tess
dialogueInline.text: She's my sister. That doesn't make every choice hers.

dialogueInline.speaker: Tess
dialogueInline.text: I called you family so I wouldn't have to stop you.

directionInline: Personal confrontation comes before violence; Abby and Tess's sisterhood is explicit.
panelPlan: Billie enters through smoke.
Tess blocks the corridor.
Their shared Shard history is visible.
Close combat ruptures the pressure window.
Billie bleeds beside the buckling barrier.

summary: Richard treats Billie while Pike abandons her; Billie refuses Abby's offered rescue.
settingText: INT./EXT. CLINIC BREACH / AURIC RING

dialogueInline.speaker: Richard
dialogueInline.text: And I am still a doctor.

dialogueInline.speaker: Abby
dialogueInline.text: So you live long enough to answer.

directionInline: No redemption: Richard acts from identity and Pike's abandonment cracks Billie's certainty.
panelPlan: Richard clamps Billie's wound.
Tess holds the failing pressure barrier.
Pike turns from Billie's distress beacon.
Abby reaches with an offered hand.
Billie escapes alone in an emergency launch.

summary: The coalition saves Auric, but every faction emerges altered and no one owns the victory.
settingText: INT./EXT. AURIC BAZAAR — AFTERMATH

dialogueInline.speaker: Kerr
dialogueInline.text: The finding is removal from command.

directionInline: Victory and punishment coexist; there is no triumphal formation.
panelPlan: Incompatible ships hold amid debris.
Locals and refugees carry wounded together.
Dain and Halev reopen shared shelter.
Abby watches Tess remain at the clinic.
Venn hears the guilty finding as testimony spreads behind her.

summary: Auric accepts refugees, rejects permanent Fleet jurisdiction, and founds an unauthorized defense compact; Tali is missing.
settingText: INT. AURIC CIVIC CHAMBER / JEX'S OFFICE

dialogueInline.speaker: Sera
dialogueInline.text: Shelter without citizenship is a waiting room.

dialogueInline.speaker: Abby
dialogueInline.text: No Shard claim over anyone who leaves.

dialogueInline.speaker: Richard
dialogueInline.text: No witness belongs to a government.

dialogueInline.speaker: Tess
dialogueInline.text: What happens when they come again?

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: We warn each other. We show up.

directionInline: The accord is narrow and fragile; Jex's cost interrupts satisfaction.
panelPlan: A mixed public chamber reconvenes.
Dain enters the shelter guarantee.
Halev strikes permanent Fleet authority.
The principals assent to mutual civilian defense.
Jex receives TALI STATUS UNKNOWN.

summary: Under Fleet detention, Venn learns the compact exists without authorization; she and Naomi acknowledge what lies between them.
settingText: INT. FLEET DETENTION TRANSIT / AURIC OBSERVATION GLASS

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: Agreed not to be in charge. It nearly killed her.

dialogueInline.speaker: Naomi
dialogueInline.text: Come back and help us make it worse.

directionInline: End with restrained intimacy and political consequence; Venn has lost rank, not agency.
panelPlan: Venn sits in a spare transit compartment without insignia.
Naomi stands against Auric observation glass.
Their permitted call connects.
Their hands align on opposite screens without touching.
Incompatible ships guard the shared shelter lights.
